ei.lesson: A Request for a Specific Delivery Date

fullPassage: To the Customer Service Team, About a month ago, my wife and I purchased a set of bookshelves from your store. I was truly excited to find furniture that perfectly matched our new home. When we bought the bookshelves, the manager said it would take four weeks for delivery, which was last weekend. We had set our plans to ensure someone would be available to receive the delivery; however, no one came with the bookshelves that day. This delay has caused us considerable inconvenience. Therefore, please provide a clear and specific delivery date. We expect this issue to be addressed promptly, so that we can reorganize our schedule to receive the delivery without any confusion.
